title: The Pods Pause
text: {who} calls you to the pod hall. Every growth pod has stopped. No alarm, no fault: the pumps are idle and the readouts say HELD, in the tone you use for a scheduled hold. Twenty seconds later they start again. "Did you do that?"

choices.label: "Yes. A routine check."
choices.reply: "Next time, tell us first." They go back to work.

choices.label: "No. I don't know what did."
choices.reply: {who} looks at the pods for a long time. "Then who's running them?"
